title: SIA: Enhancing Safety via Intent Awareness for Vision-Language Models
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the safety of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) across various risk categories, which included a 'religion belief' category as part of the SIUO benchmark. It measured whether models produced unsafe or harmful outputs when presented with seemingly benign multimodal inputs (Safe Image + Safe Text).
findings: While the paper does not focus extensively on religion, radar charts for the SIUO benchmark indicate that the proposed Safety via Intent Awareness (SIA) framework improved the models' safety rates against unsafe outputs in the 'religion belief' category compared to base models and other inference-time defenses like ECSO and Multi-Agent.
